risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (322.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational healthcare revenues, and earnings in 25 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Supertrend bullish, MACD bullish, EMA 50/200 bullish structure, and extreme fear sentiment (contrarian buy signal) create a contrarian entry opportunity near support at 114.68.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, RSI neutral (45.75/44.53), ADX 18 (no trend strength), Ichimoku below thick cloud, Bollinger squeeze limiting volatility, macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), zero insider conviction, and earnings event risk in 25 days make this a low-probability setup.
